```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

# Define the columns to check
rate_columns <- c("iorb", "disct", "ffr", "repo")

# Function to identify rows to remove based on zeros and their context
check_rows_to_remove <- function(data, col) {
  # Identify rows where the value is zero
  zeros <- data[[col]] == 0
  # Identify NA values
  nas <- is.na(data[[col]])
  # Find zeros near NAs (previous or next row)
  near_nas <- c(FALSE, nas[-length(nas)]) | c(nas[-1], FALSE)
  
  # Check for isolated zeros
  isolated_zeros <- zeros & !c(zeros[-1], FALSE) & !c(FALSE, zeros[-length(zeros)])
  
  # Define a threshold for significant difference
  threshold <- 0.1 # Changeable percentage; here it means 10%
  prev_values <- c(NA, data[[col]][-length(data[[col]])])
  next_values <- c(data[[col]][-1], NA)
  
  # Find zeros significantly different from neighbors
  significant_diff <- zeros & (
    (abs(data[[col]] - prev_values) / prev_values > threshold | is.na(prev_values)) |
    (abs(data[[col]] - next_values) / next_values > threshold | is.na(next_values))
  )
  
  # Combine all criteria
  bad_indices <- which(near_nas | isolated_zeros | significant_diff)
  bad_indices
}

# Apply function to each column and combine indices
bad_rows <- map(rate_columns, ~check_rows_to_remove(Zheng_Zhengtai_exercise3, .x)) %>%
  unlist() %>%
  unique()

# Remove bad rows
Zheng_Zhengtai_exercise3_cleaned <- Zheng_Zhengtai_exercise3[-bad_rows, ]

write.xlsx(Zheng_Zhengtai_exercise3_cleaned, file = "Zheng_Zhengtai_exercise3.xlsx")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

library(readxl)
Zheng_Zhengtai_exercise3 <- read_excel("Zheng_Zhengtai_exercise3.xlsx")

# Ensure the date column is treated as a Date object
Zheng_Zhengtai_exercise3_cleaned$date <- as.Date(Zheng_Zhengtai_exercise3_cleaned$date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")

# Ploting
ggplot(data = Zheng_Zhengtai_exercise3_cleaned, aes(x = date)) +
  theme_linedraw() + 
  geom_line(aes(y = iorb, color = "IORB", linetype = "IORB"), size = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = disct, color = "Discount Rate", linetype = "Discount Rate"), size = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = ffr, color = "FFR", linetype = "FFR"), size = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = repo, color = "Repo Rate", linetype = "Repo Rate"), size = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("IORB" = "blue", "Discount Rate" = "purple", "FFR" = "red", "Repo Rate" = "green2")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("IORB" = "longdash", "Discount Rate" = "dashed", "FFR" = "solid", "Repo Rate" = "twodash")) +
  labs(title = "Interest Rates Over Time",
       x = "Date",
       y = "Interest Rate (%)",
       color = "Rate Type",
       linetype = "Rate Type") +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.title.x = element_blank()) 
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Create a comparison vector
comparison <- Zheng_Zhengtai_exercise3_cleaned$ffr > Zheng_Zhengtai_exercise3_cleaned$iorb

above_count <- sum(comparison, na.rm = TRUE)
below_count <- sum(!comparison, na.rm = TRUE)  

plot_data <- data.frame(
  Condition = c("FFR Above IORB", "FFR Below or Equal to IORB"),
  Count = c(above_count, below_count)
)

# Calculate percentages
total_counts <- sum(plot_data$Count)
plot_data$Percentage <- plot_data$Count / total_counts * 100

# Create the pie chart
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = "", y = Count, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  theme_void() +  # Remove extra elements
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FFR Above IORB" = "red2", "FFR Below or Equal to IORB" = "steelblue2")) +
  labs(title = "Percentage of Time FFR is Above vs Below IORB",
       fill = "Condition") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Percentage)), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5))
```
